bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
if test -x node_modules/.bin/tsx; then echo HOST_TSX_PRESENT; exit 0; fi
if test -x artifacts/bot/node_modules/.bin/tsx; then echo BOT_TSX_PRESENT; exit 0; fi
if test -x node_modules/.bin/esbuild; then echo HOST_ESBUILD_PRESENT; exit 0; fi
if test -x artifacts/bot/node_modules/.bin/esbuild; then echo BOT_ESBUILD_PRESENT; exit 0; fi
if docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 test -f /app/publishThreeRegisteredTopicEntries.mjs; then echo EXISTING_OPERATOR_PRESENT; exit 0; fi
if docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 test -f /app/gaybbs.mjs; then echo RUNTIME_BUNDLE_ONLY; exit 42; fi
exit 44
